description: The best-rated profiles in a category, optionally in one area, ranked by average rating and then by number of reviews: the answer to "who is a good X in Y". Unrated profiles come last and say so.

language.description: Language of the names and links in the answer (default es).

limit.description: How many profiles to return, up to 10 (default 5).

place.description: Area name; only areas with at least three profiles are listed separately, otherwise all of the category is returned.

name: top_rated
